title: 1961 Family Portrait Outside Home, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot stamped 'FEB 1961' showing a multi-generational family of four posing outside a wood-sided house. An older man in a dark suit and tie stands alongside an older woman, while a younger woman and girl sit on the porch steps. The image captures everyday domestic life in early 1960s suburban America.
